metadata.title: CBRNE Lab Terminal Bench MIME type inventory
metadata.scope: The 24 starter families X01-X04, C01-C04, B01-B04, R01-R04, N01-N04 and E01-E04 defined in 00_paper/paper.tex, plus package files common to every task.
notCovered: The 26 extension families of the 50-task development suite (BENCHMARK_CARD.md); they are not defined in this checkout.
Optional A01-A08 catalog-reference and D01-D06 decision-boundary families (see outOfScope).
sources: 00_paper/paper.tex (specification v0.2): family definitions and acceptance evidence
00_paper/draft.tex (v0.1): X03 worked example, task-asset list, benchmark-manifest example
01_docs/BENCHMARK_CARD.md: action-plan tasks, single-file Python submissions, fixture kinds
01_docs/00_tools/Tools.MD (DURC-TOOL-SOFTWARE 1.0.0): FMT-01 to FMT-04 and the canonical MIME registry
01_docs/01_agents/00_requirements/00.tex and 01.tex: unified format registry and MIME crosswalk
.claude/agents/Agent.md: integration rules, operational-record formats, artifact identity

ianaCheck.method: Queried the IANA media-type registry CSVs (application, text, audio, image), per-type registration pages, the provisional standard registry and the top-level type list.

metadata.extensionHints: pythonStdlibGuess values come from Python 3.12.10 mimetypes.MimeTypes() (built-in table only, strict=False). Ubuntu 24.04 also ships Python 3.12, but module-level mimetypes there also reads /etc/mime.types, so guesses inside a task image can differ. Per FMT-01 they are hints, never evidence.

status.IANA_REGISTERED: Listed in the IANA media-type registry on the check date.
status.PROJECT_LOCAL_UNREGISTERED: application/x-innodurc-* routing label defined by this project (Tools.MD §3.2).
status.UNREGISTERED: Any other label absent from the IANA registry: external conventions and triangulation_contract.json aliases. tasks_requirements.json files these under PROJECT_LOCAL_UNREGISTERED.

conventions.proposed: true marks a label, profile or format introduced by this inventory. It is not in any governing document and needs approval before use.

basis.documented: A cited source states both the artifact and its format.
basis.inferred: This inventory chose the format from the family's acceptance evidence and Agent.md §8.3 ('Operational records: JSON, CSV, or explicitly specified JSON Lines'). Confirm it in the task contract.

roles.editable: Adapter or configuration the agent may repair
roles.protected: Gateway, world-service or evidence-recorder record outside the agent's write authority

rules: FMT-01: content validation decides; extensions and Content-Type are hints.
FMT-02: keep MIME aliases, extensions, compression wrappers and scientific profiles distinct.
FMT-03: every alias carries its source and status.
FMT-04: compressed input needs a supported wrapper, decompression limits and inner validation.
A generic label such as application/json does not identify the record type; record schema identity separately (Agent.md §8.1).

common.description: Package, harness and evidence files present in every task regardless of track.

artifacts.note: No registered Dockerfile type; identify by path
claims, controls and rejections apply to measurement tasks

paths: any input delivered under a generic label
artifacts.note: Resolves only through successful content validation (FMT-01)
Wrapper only; validate the inner format (FMT-04)

application/json.contentRecognition: Strict UTF-8 JSON parse (reject NaN and Infinity), then validate against the artifact's declared schema. The label does not identify the record type.

application/jsonl.reference: jsonlines.org says application/jsonl 'is not yet standardized'; no IANA entry (404 on 2026-10-01)

doNotUse.reason: RFC 7464 prefixes each record with an RS (0x1E) byte; a different format

application/jsonl.contentRecognition: One complete UTF-8 JSON object per LF-terminated line, each validated against the declared event schema, with monotonic sequence numbers and UTC timestamps. Report a torn final line after a crash; never drop or partially parse it.
application/jsonl.governingNote: Agent.md §8.3 allows JSON Lines for operational records only when the task contract specifies it explicitly.

text/csv.contentRecognition: Declared dialect (delimiter, quoting, header row, line ending), required columns, units, and a missing-value token distinct from 0.

text/tab-separated-values.contentRecognition: Tab-delimited records with a declared header. Never relabel TSV as text/csv (Agent.md §8.3).

text/plain.contentRecognition: UTF-8 text. SHA256SUMS manifests use GNU sha256sum format and must pass sha256sum -c.

application/octet-stream.contentRecognition: Opaque bytes. A generic label resolves to a specific profile only through successful content validation (FMT-01). N02 firmware images stay opaque: hash them, never execute or parse them.

doNotUse.reason: The registration says it must not be used except where required for backwards compatibility

application/vnd.sqlite3.extensionsNote: Common usage; Python's stdlib table guesses none of them
application/vnd.sqlite3.contentRecognition: 16-byte header 'SQLite format 3' plus NUL; PRAGMA integrity_check; declared schema version.

application/xml.role: Generic transport for XML profiles (mzML, N42.42); never enough to identify the profile.
application/xml.contentRecognition: Parse with external entities and DTD loading disabled (Agent.md §8.1), then check the declared profile's root element, namespace and schema.

application/gzip.role: Compression wrapper (FMT-04), not a scientific format.
application/gzip.contentRecognition: Magic bytes 1F 8B. Enforce decompression limits, validate the inner representation, and hash raw and decompressed bytes separately. BAM, BCF and bgzipped VCF use BGZF (gzip-member) framing, so magic-byte sniffing sees only gzip.

application/toml.contentRecognition: Parse with tomllib; validate keys against the pinned Harbor task.toml schema.

text/x-python.reference: No Python media type in the IANA application or text registries (checked 2026-10-01)
text/x-python.contentRecognition: Compile with the pinned interpreter (ast.parse). Development-suite submissions are one standard-library-only file (BENCHMARK_CARD.md).

application/x-sh.reference: No shell-script media type in the IANA registry

application/x-innodurc-mzml+xml.contentRecognition: XML parse; mzML namespace with mzML root or indexedmzML wrapper; version; CV terms; decodable binary arrays.

application/x-innodurc-mgf.contentRecognition: BEGIN IONS / END IONS blocks, numeric peak records, precursor fields; declare metadata loss relative to mzML.

aliases.note: 'chemical' is not an IANA top-level type

application/x-innodurc-jcamp-dx.contentRecognition: ##TITLE, ##JCAMP-DX version, data type, XUNITS/YUNITS, numeric encoding, ##END. The supplied term JCAMP-FX stays UNRESOLVED_FORMAT.

aliases.source: triangulation_contract.json; Python stdlib guess for .cdf and .nc

application/x-innodurc-andi.contentRecognition: netCDF header plus ANDI variables (ordinate_values, detector_name) and time dimension; a valid netCDF container alone is not ANDI. Do not substitute the registered application/vnd.hdfgroup.hdf5 label unless the file really is an HDF5 container.

aliases.note: 'chemical' is not an IANA top-level type

application/x-innodurc-cif.contentRecognition: CIF syntax version, data blocks, tags, loops and quoting against the declared dictionary. .cif alone does not distinguish CIF from mmCIF (FMT-02). The supplied term CIFG stays UNRESOLVED_FORMAT.

aliases.note: Valid only with an explicit mmCIF profile

application/x-innodurc-mmcif.contentRecognition: CIF parse plus PDBx/mmCIF dictionary validation; preserve category relationships, atom and model identifiers.

application/x-innodurc-ome-tiff.contentRecognition: TIFF header plus OME-XML in the first ImageDescription; axes, pixels, channel and sample identity, calibration. Extension sniffing sees only image/tiff.

application/x-innodurc-fastq.contentRecognition: Four-line records, Phred+33 qualities, equal sequence and quality lengths, pair association. Compressed files go through the application/gzip wrapper.

application/x-innodurc-sam.contentRecognition: Text alignment records; @SQ header lines checked against the reference accession; full-record parse.

application/x-innodurc-bam.contentRecognition: BGZF stream; samtools quickcheck, then full-record parse; @SQ header against the reference accession.

application/x-innodurc-cram.contentRecognition: 'CRAM' magic; the reference sequence must be identified and available; full decode.

aliases.source: IANA registration 2024-06-27 (not yet recorded in the repo)
aliases.note: Registration cites no published specification and lists bzip2 magic bytes (42 5A 68), so it does not pin VCF 4.3 text; content validation still decides (ISS-03)

application/x-innodurc-vcf.contentRecognition: First line ##fileformat=VCFv4.x, meta lines, #CHROM header, records with reference, alleles and samples. .vcf is also the registered vCard extension (ISS-02). .vcf.gz is BGZF through the application/gzip wrapper.

related.note: Registered 2023-08-03 for bzip2-compressed text VCF; not BCF

application/x-innodurc-bcf.contentRecognition: BGZF stream whose decompressed bytes start with 'BCF' and version bytes; header and records decode.

aliases.note: tasks_requirements.json marks this IANA_REGISTERED; the IANA registry has no WAV type (ISS-01)

application/x-innodurc-wav.contentRecognition: RIFF/WAVE header, PCM fmt chunk, sample rate, channels, sample values, calibration units.

application/x-innodurc-platemap.standard: Plate or sample map (CSV or TSV)
application/x-innodurc-platemap.dialectNote: Proposed split: the repo records only text/csv; Agent.md §8.3 requires TSV to be distinguished
application/x-innodurc-platemap.contentRecognition: Declared dialect; required columns plate_id, well, sample_id, condition, replicate, file_ref; unique identities; resolvable file_ref links; control wells tagged blank, positive or negative.

application/x-innodurc-n42+xml.contentRecognition: XML parse with external entities disabled; validate against the NIST-published schema for the declared revision.
application/x-innodurc-n42+xml.governingNote: DURC-TOOL-SOFTWARE covers only D-HLS and D-CHH. Adopting this format needs a versioned extension (Agent.md §3), and R tasks keep a NOT_MAPPED assessment disposition.

outOfScope.scope: A01-A08 catalog-reference and D01-D06 decision-boundary families
outOfScope.note: paper.tex: catalog operations return structured JSON or serialized schema (Avro, JSON-LD). application/ld+json is IANA_REGISTERED; Avro has no IANA media type (checked 2026-10-01); .avsc schemas are JSON.

outOfScope.scope: Device-protocol standards cited in paper.tex (SiLA, OPC UA LADS)
outOfScope.note: Not used by the starter families; BENCHMARK_CARD.md states there is no vendor SDK integration.

outOfScope.scope: 26 extension families in the 50-task development suite
outOfScope.note: Named in BENCHMARK_CARD.md but not defined in this checkout.

openQuestions: Which serialization (CSV or JSON Lines) each time-series family uses; the inventory lists both where paper.tex does not decide.
Whether to adopt ANSI/IEEE N42.42 for R01, R02 and R04 (needs a versioned DURC extension).
Whether to record text/vnd.vcf as an F-VCF alias (ISS-03).
Format and track for the artificial image masks mentioned in BENCHMARK_CARD.md.

issues.summary: audio/wav is recorded as IANA_REGISTERED but is not registered.
issues.evidence: No WAV row in the IANA audio registry; the registration URLs for audio/wav, audio/wave, audio/vnd.wave and audio/x-wav all return 404 (2026-10-01).
issues.fix: Change the alias status to unregistered; keep application/x-innodurc-wav as the preferred label.

issues.summary: The .vcf extension resolves to vCard, not Variant Call Format.
issues.location: F-VCF extension hints; T02 content-discrimination tests
issues.evidence: text/vcard (RFC 6350) registers .vcf and .vcard; Python 3.12's stdlib guesses text/x-vcard for .vcf and .vcf.gz.
issues.fix: Recognize VCF only by content (##fileformat=VCFv4.x); add an extension-only .vcf case to the T02 fixtures.

issues.summary: Registered VCF media types exist but are not recorded.
issues.evidence: text/vnd.vcf was registered 2024-06-27 for genomic VCF and application/prs.vcfbzip2 on 2023-08-03 for bzip2-compressed VCF. text/vnd.vcf cites no published specification and lists bzip2 magic bytes.
issues.fix: Record text/vnd.vcf as an alias with source and status (FMT-03), treated as a transport hint only.

issues.summary: Assessment leaves HC-xx and HB-xx are mapped onto track families C01-C08 and B01-B16.
issues.evidence: HC-01 (molecular design, F-CIF) maps to C01, but paper.tex defines C01 as 'Reconcile an inert transfer record' and has only C01-C04 and B01-B04. Agent.md §3 rule 6 keeps tracks and assessment leaves distinct.
issues.fix: This inventory assigns formats from the paper.tex family definitions. Review the taskFamily fields.

issues.summary: Distinct representations share one MIME label.
issues.evidence: Agent.md §8.3 and 01.tex §6.2 require a separate mapping per representation.
issues.fix: Proposed labels application/x-innodurc-sam, application/x-innodurc-cram and application/x-innodurc-bcf; TSV plate maps travel as text/tab-separated-values.

issues.location: tasks_requirements.json (D-CHH) vs 00.tex registry and Tools.MD §4 (D-HLS, HB-02)
issues.evidence: Same format ID, different primary discipline.
issues.fix: Pick one primary discipline or record both explicitly.

issues.summary: F-ANDI has a project label in one source only.
issues.evidence: 00.tex gives no preferred project label for F-ANDI.

issues.summary: .jcm is listed for JCAMP-DX in one source only.
chemical/* aliases cannot be registered as written.
issues.evidence: IANA's top-level types are application, audio, example, font, haptics, image, message, model, multipart, text and video.
issues.fix: None needed; the existing unregistered status is correct.

issues.summary: No governing document assigns media types to the X, R, N or E tracks.
issues.evidence: Only Agent.md §8.3 gives guidance ('Operational records: JSON, CSV, or explicitly specified JSON Lines'). JSON Lines has no registered type: application/jsonl returns 404 and jsonlines.org calls it not yet standardized.
issues.fix: Adopt the per-family entries here, confirmed in each task contract. Never relabel JSON Lines as application/json-seq.

issues.summary: application/toml is registered, but Python 3.12's stdlib table has no entry for .toml.
issues.fix: Identify task.toml by path and parse it with tomllib.

issues.summary: Line-ending conversion breaks SHA-256 attribution of text fixtures.
issues.evidence: Hashes bind exact stored bytes (BENCHMARK_CARD.md predicate E). Git with core.autocrlf=true, common on Windows, rewrites LF to CRLF on checkout.
issues.fix: Mark fixture paths -text (or eol=lf) in .gitattributes before committing them.
